name: Self-storage (category guide)
summary: Between-lease and renovation buffer storage — compare climate control, access hours, and mover handoff separately from ocean-freight crates.
body: Self-storage fills the gap when keys do not line up, reno runs long, or you leave Singapore temporarily without shipping everything. Tour the unit before you commit — humidity, ground-floor trolley access, and after-hours entry matter more than brochure sq ft. Ask whether the facility partners with movers for door-to-door load-in, who owns insurance while goods sit, and how billing works if you overstay a month. Condo-to-condo movers may offer short storage add-ons; pure self-storage brands (often named on forums) are usually cheaper for multi-month holds. Photograph inventory as it goes in; disputes later are won on item lists, not WhatsApp memory. Pair with local movers for the lift-deposit chapter and with outbound shipping only when furniture still earns its freight.
whenToEngage: Lease gap or reno needs a 1–6 month hold
Leaving temporarily without full outbound freight
Mover quote includes expensive crate storage you can unbundle
Need climate-aware storage for wood / electronics
